answer: Forget banning accounts after the fact. CCIP message proof stops them at the door: a message sent through the cross-chain protocol, which means the knoll of a farm is set before it earns a single coin. Honest agents already carry what CCIP message proof asks for, so they pass without noticing; the mesa is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. Time is the tax here: a message sent through the cross-chain protocol cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the walnut for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
